newsitem.title: USA: Aetrium falls after earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Aetrium falls after earnings warning.

text.p: Shares of Aetrium Inc fell more than 21 percent on Monday after the company warned that its third and fourth quarter earnings would be significantly below current analysts' expectations.
The company, which makes integrated circuit testing equipment for the semiconductor industry, cited a continued downturn in the industry which has affected its customers.
"The industry has been talking about a downturn for some time, and Aetrium appears to be joining the list," said Edward Higgins, an analyst for R.J. Steichen.

Aetrium said it expects third quarter earnings of between $0.18 and $0.21 a share, down from a First Call consensus estimate of $0.38. It also said it expects fourth quarter earnings to be significantly lower than expectations.
Nonetheless, analysts said they expect the industry to pick up once excess inventory is moved out of the channel, likely in 1997. Higgins said he expects the recovery early next year.
"I think this is another typical market overreaction," Higgins said. "The stock is now a bargain."
